profile.headline: Software Engineer Manager
profile.summary:
Currently working with a large scale AX 2009 implementation with several outside software integrations. Responsible for business analysis and requirements gathering as well as architecting and developing solutions.

Specialties: X++, Microsoft Dynamics AX 2009, & 4.0, A+ Certified in both Hardware and Software, MCSA, HTML, Java, Perl, Python, and C programming experiance.

positions.title: Software Engineer Manager
positions.description: Senior developer for Microsoft Dynamics AX ERP solution.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for the development, implementation, and support of Dynamics AX ERP system.Participate in development, customization, and integration of Axapta applications with other applications including .NET & SQL for the corporation. Deliver high quality software solutions by utilizing the following software tools:
SQL, Visual Basic, XML, C++, HTML, C#, ASP, .NET, X++

positions.title: PC Technician
positions.description:
Supported an enterprise level atmosphere with 300 users in the Lancaster division and 2,000 users corporate wide. Maintained Microsoft Server (2003 and 2008), SQL databases, and Microsoft Dynamics AX ERP system. Implemented enterprise wide help desk solution. Created project plan for Office 2007 rollout and SharePoint 2007 rollout.
Facilitated all IT purchasing decisions.   
Evaluated new enterprise level hardware and software solutions. 
PC troubleshooting including diagnostic test procedures.
Responsible for all computer equipment repairs and software installation.
Provided network support.
Administered the print server and terminal services server.
Windows Batch Scripting

positions.title: In-home Installer
positions.description:
Utilized several technologies such as wireless networking and a wide variety of diagnostic tools. Installed numerous types of VOIP systems (Verizon, Comcast, and Vonage).
PC troubleshooting including diagnostic test procedures.
Software and computer equipment repair.
Installation, support and networking of consumer electronics.

positions.title: Assistant Store Manager
positions.description:
Skilled at evaluating options and generating solutions.
Analyzed store's financial data and take action to increase revenues, control costs, 
      and ensure appropriate inventory management to achieve sales and profit goals.
Experienced in successful management of diverse groups of people.

positions.title: Store Manager
positions.description:
Recruit, hire, train, and evaluate store employees.
Executed sales service models and strategies to achieve sales and service goals.
Established history of improving operations and increasing profitability.

positions.title: Technology Specialist
positions.description:
Responsible for all computer upgrades and repairs.
Accountable for sales and technical support of all electronic products.
Provided onsite installations and technical training.

educations.degreeName: Associates of Arts; Bachelors of Science
